governance.authority: Episode Stage semantics and Stage-code sets are defined here and selected by immutable Evaluation Context artifacts. Stage is exclusively training/Episode process vocabulary and never denotes project progress or P capability maturity.
governance.conflict_rule: Higher precedence wins only within an overlapping candidate interval; lower-precedence candidates remain evidence but are not published as current stage.
governance.revision_rule: Corrections create a new stage row linked by supersedes_stage_id; never mutate published historical stages.
governance.boundary_rule: Stage must be wholly inside its Episode and must not cross an Episode revision boundary.
governance.quality_rule: Each stage carries status, coverage, confidence and detector_version.
governance.profile_extension_rule: New training types add a versioned profile here; they do not create an alternate Stage schema. Profile activation is controlled by immutable Context artifacts and P capability maturity/feature gates.

semantics.MERGE: Configured engagement entry and initial relative-state interval.
semantics.WEAPON_ENVELOPE: Training-rule-defined engagement-opportunity interval; not a real-world weapon optimization product.

semantics.DETECTION: Training-relevant information acquisition opportunity and detection interval.
semantics.WEAPON_EMPLOYMENT: Observed training engagement action and support interval.
semantics.ASSESSMENT: Approved adjudication, recovery and post-event evidence interval.

semantics.ROUTE_TASK_EXECUTION: Scenario-defined route/profile/task execution interval; system does not synthesize an optimal attack route.
semantics.TARGET_INFORMATION_AVAILABLE: Target information becomes relevant/available under declared P/world capability.
semantics.TARGET_ASSOCIATION: Truth-to-perception/assignment association and task-target linkage interval.
semantics.DESIGNATION_TRACK: Observed designation/track continuity and target-ID stability interval.
semantics.TRAINING_ATTACK_EVENT: Observed training release/trigger/attempt action interval; not an official result.
semantics.RANGE_SIM_ADJUDICATION: Approved range/simulator adjudication association interval; absent J yields no official outcome claim.
semantics.POST_EVENT_TASK_TRANSITION: Observed post-event action, handoff or task-transition interval.

legacy_reference_mappings.rule: Legacy sets are analysis/event-state vocabulary only. They are not alternate current episode_stage schemas or stage-code authorities.
